title: Mass-metallicity archive census: reach versus eligibility
short_title: Archive reach is not scientific eligibility
tts_instructions: Measured scientific-conference narration in Alloy. Calm, precise, and authoritative. Motivate the first four sentences warmly and conditionally, with no result cadence. Give semantic adjudication the strongest intellectual emphasis. Do not imply that an eligibility value has been revealed.

sentences.text: Archive metadata can make a table look ready for a mass-metallicity census in two very different ways.
sentences.display_citation: VizieR metadata ledger · semantic eligibility design

sentences.text: If mass, gas-phase abundance, and redshift were genuinely joined within one galaxy sample, that would let us test how enrichment changes with galaxy mass across cosmic time.

sentences.text: But an apparent three-axis match could instead be a fact about archive symbols and metadata, not about a galaxy sample.

sentences.text: How do we tell a reachable table from an eligible one?

params.subtitle: THE QUESTION THAT DRIVES THE METHOD
params.left_body: a coherent sample can test enrichment across mass and cosmic time
params.right_body: symbols and tags only look scientifically compatible
params.question: HOW DO WE TELL REACH FROM ELIGIBILITY?

sentences.text: Counting metadata hits cannot settle that question, because one symbol can name redshift, Galactic height, or a model-grid composition.

params.heading: WHY A HIT COUNT CANNOT SETTLE IT
params.left: SCIENTIFIC AXIS IN A GALAXY TABLE

sentences.text: The census therefore needs evidence that the required quantities refer to the right physical species, phase, and parent sample in the same table.

params.heading: THE AMBIGUITY IS SEMANTIC
params.left: RIGHT QUANTITIES, SAME SAMPLE, GAS PHASE

sentences.text: The discriminating move is semantic adjudication, performed on every candidate under clauses frozen before any eligibility value is computed.
For each required axis, the adjudicator reads the column name, the UCD qualifier, and the archived description rather than trusting the tag alone.
sentences.display_citation: Recorded evidence payload for each axis

params.heading: READ THE EVIDENCE BEHIND EACH TAG

sentences.text: Abundance must describe an element ratio in gas, mass must be stellar mass, and redshift must identify the galaxy rather than a foreground coordinate.
Only a same-table evidence chain can support eligibility; a metadata coincidence remains on the other side of the decision boundary.

params.heading: SAME TABLE, SAME SAMPLE, RIGHT MEANING

sentences.text: That decision rule is what separates a census of scientific holdings from a census of search vocabulary, while leaving the final value withheld.

params.heading: REACH AND ELIGIBILITY ARE DIFFERENT OBJECTS

sentences.text: First, record every archive table reached by mass, abundance, and redshift metadata, without treating any retrieval total as a scientific sample.

params.heading: RECORD STAGES WITHOUT PUBLISHING OUTPUTS
params.banner: STAGE OUTPUTS WITHHELD · NO ELIGIBILITY COUNT

sentences.text: Then apply the frozen modifier filter and semantic clauses, while withholding every stage total and the final eligibility fraction.

params.heading: KEEP THE PIPELINE, WITHHOLD EVERY TOTAL
params.banner: NO SOURCE FREEZE · NO STAGE RESULT

sentences.text: The estimator is built progressively as eligible samples over adjudicated metadata candidates, with no evaluated fraction shown.

params.heading: BUILD THE ESTIMATOR WITHOUT REVEALING IT

sentences.text: The denominator must be the adjudicated candidate set, because dividing by raw search hits would turn retrieval noise into a scientific rate.

params.heading: THE DENOMINATOR IS PART OF THE CLAIM

sentences.text: Recall controls test whether the retrieval misses known holdings, while exclusion decoys test whether metadata collisions slip through.

params.heading: CONTROL THE RETRIEVAL AND THE SEMANTICS

sentences.text: Species, phase, and same-table checks are bias controls by design; this canary does not display their outcomes.

params.heading: EACH CONTROL TARGETS A FAILURE MODE

sentences.text: We tied our own hands by freezing the axes, evidence clauses, exclusions, and denominator before applying the eligibility rule.

params.bottom: THE STANDARD CANNOT MOVE AFTER THE LEDGER IS SEEN

sentences.text: The review gates are self-imposed scientific discipline: later convenience cannot redefine what an eligible mass-metallicity sample means.
What is known is the retrieval design and source accounting; eligibility, its fraction, and any scientific interpretation remain outside this canary.
Ask the opening question again: are we seeing coherent galaxy tables, or only the vocabulary of the archive?
Now we have a method that can tell those explanations apart without pretending that a result has already been authorized.

params.heading: THE METHOD EARNS THE ANSWER
params.banner: NO RESULT CLAIM IN THIS CANARY
